settings.title: Settings
settings.forbidden: This page is for administrators only

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Review file sizes and availability for your selected company.
storage.companyScope: The list covers files you can access in your selected company.
storage.tenantScope: These totals cover the whole organization.
storage.name: File name
storage.empty: No accessible files match this filter.
storage.manageHint: Open a linked record to manage files using that application’s permissions.

branding.managedIdentity: Name and logo are on the Company profile page. Here is the company colour for documents and reports only, not the interface.
branding.primaryHint: Used in invoices, reports and printouts only. It does not change the interface colors.

address.title: National address
address.hint: This address appears on invoices and official documents.

company.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB
company.name: Company name
company.taglineHint: A short line shown with the company name on documents.
company.vatRegisteredHint: The VAT number becomes required and tax shows on orders, invoices and pay pages. Earlier documents stay as issued.
company.vatManageHint: Only the system administrator can change the VAT registration and number.
company.vatHint: A tax number in the format of the company's country.
company.countryFixed: Set when the account was created; it cannot be changed.

errors.logoFormat: Use a PNG or JPEG image
errors.logoSize: The logo must not exceed 2 MB
errors.logoRead: Could not read the logo image
errors.vatRequired: Enter the VAT number before registering the company for VAT

creators.label: Who can create projects
creators.hint: The people allowed to start a new project in the company.

defaultStages.label: Default stages for new projects
defaultStages.hint: Copied into every new project; existing ones are not affected.

createRequirements.hint: A project cannot be created until a manager is chosen.
createRequirements.endDateHint: A project cannot be created until its end date is set.

charterApproval.label: Sponsor approval of the charter
charterApproval.hint: The manager sends the charter to the sponsor, and it is approved only with their consent.

closeWithOpenTasks.label: Closing a project with open tasks
closeWithOpenTasks.hint: Choose whether closing is blocked or allowed after the manager confirms.

registerTransitions.label: Risk and issue status changes
registerTransitions.hint: A status moves to the next neighbouring status only, or straight to any status.

changeControl.label: Scope and budget change requests
changeControl.hint: Choose when an approved change request is needed to edit scope and budget during execution.
changeControl.offHint: No change requests. Editing an approved charter sends it back for review if charter approval is on.
changeControl.optionalHint: Requests are available and block nothing. An approved charter returns to draft when edited, unless a request is approved.
changeControl.requiredHint: Scope, budget, going back a phase and a new baseline are blocked unless an approved change request covers them.

baselineGate.label: Baseline before execution
baselineGate.hint: Choose when a baseline (the frozen plan) is required before execution starts.
baselineGate.offHint: The project moves to execution without mentioning a baseline.
baselineGate.warningHint: The gate warns that no baseline exists; the manager confirms and continues.
baselineGate.requiredHint: The project cannot move to execution until a baseline is approved.

evmProgress.label: Progress for earned value
evmProgress.hint: How a task's percent complete is counted when earned value is measured.
evmProgress.binaryHint: A done task is 100% and any other is 0%, with no extra entry.
evmProgress.manualHint: The assignee enters 0 to 100 percent; a done task stays at 100%.

changeCategories.title: Change request categories
changeCategories.hint: The categories a requester picks from. Archiving keeps the category on the requests that carry it.
changeCategories.name: Category name

extensions.title: Connected applications
extensions.hint: Options that installed applications add to projects.

approval.label: Task completion approval
approval.hint: Applies to new projects only; existing ones stay as they are.

reminders.label: Deadline reminders
reminders.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 30
reminders.digest: Daily overdue summary for the project manager
reminders.hint: Covers current eligible tasks by their dates and status; it creates no new tasks.
reminders.enabledHint: The reminder reaches the inbox before the task deadline.
reminders.daysBeforeHint: How many days ahead of the deadline the reminder arrives.

catalogs.title: Shared reference lists
catalogs.hint: Project types and owning units used in project files.
catalogs.name: Name
catalogs.empty: This list has no values yet.
catalogs.loadError: The catalog could not be loaded.

confirm.disable: Disable “{name}”? It remains visible on charters that already use it.
confirm.delete: Delete “{name}”? This is allowed only when it is unused.

errors.sequence: Sequence must be a whole number.
errors.inUse: A value that is still in use cannot be deleted.

catalogs.charterStepsHint: The steps a charter of this classification walks through. Basics and review are always present.

creation.title: Project creation policy
creation.hint: Rules for starting a new project. Existing projects are not changed.

defaults.title: Project defaults
defaults.hint: Stages and completion approval are copied into each new project; existing ones are unchanged.

tools.title: Project tool policy
tools.hint: Applies to every project. Enabled tools run in all projects; optional ones are chosen per project.
tools.governanceConflict: Turn governance on, or switch off the charter, change and baseline requirements, in the same save.
tools.planningConflict: Turn planning on, or switch off the baseline requirement, in the same save.

financeReaders.label: Who sees project finance
financeReaders.hint: Budget, costs and earned value. Project managers and owners always see them. With "Project members", members who can also view projects see them too.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.modeHint: Choose a light or dark appearance
appearance.savedForYou: Saved to your account and applied wherever you sign in.

maintenance.title: Maintenance scheduling
maintenance.preferenceHint: Save your weekly preference, then explicitly book each published release. Saving a preference does not schedule an update.
maintenance.noReleases: No maintenance releases have been published.
maintenance.sharedScope: It affects a shared service; the operator coordinates the window for all affected customers.
maintenance.dstHint: Ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times are rejected. Choose another time.
maintenance.invalid: Check the timezone, timing, duration and release selection.
maintenance.keepDraft: Your draft is preserved. Refresh the data, then use Discard draft to load the latest settings before reapplying your changes.
